\begin{example} \end{example}[Free products with amalgamation] ↗ thm:graph-of-groups-is-kg1 ↗ ex:xmn-universal-cover-construction 1. ch1:1B.12\group Fundamental Group

For injective maps $C\to A$ and $C\to B$, the graph of groups $A\leftarrow C\to B$ has fundamental group $A*_C B$, containing $A$ and $B$. Taking $A=B=C=\Z $ with degree-$m$ and degree-$n$ maps gives $\langle a,b\mid a^m=b^n\rangle $. \end{example}
